'''Earth Bolt''' is an [[Earth spells|earth]]-based [[Bolt spells|bolt spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 29 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

==Damage==
Earth Bolt's base maximum hit starts at 11 and increases to 12 when the player unlocks [[Fire Bolt]] at level 35 Magic. Players who have completed the [[Family Crest]] quest can wear [[Chaos gauntlets]] to increase the maximum hit by an additional +3, up to 15.

As with all combat spells, Earth Bolt's maximum hit is also increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As an earth-based spell, Earth Bolt's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to earth]].
